mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from ${msg_table} where MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '0' and NVL(RSVT_DT,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE and SNDNG_DT is null and MSG_SE_CD = '${msg_type}' and BIZ_MSG_SE_CD = 'AT' and GROUP_NO is null
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '1', GROUP_NO = '${group_no}' where DAT_ID in ( select DAT_ID from ${msg_table} where MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '0' and NVL(RSVT_DT,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE and SNDNG_DT is null and MSG_SE_CD = '${msg_type}' and BIZ_MSG_SE_CD = 'AT' and GROUP_NO is null fetch first 1000 rows only )
mapper.select: select trim(DAT_ID) as DATA_ID, trim(case when BIZ_MSG_SE_CD is null or BIZ_MSG_SE_CD = '' then 'PH' else BIZ_MSG_SE_CD end) as message_type, LTR_MSG_CN as msg_txt, LTR_MSG_CN as sms_txt, trim((case when RCVR_TELNO like '82%' then RCVR_TELNO when RCVR_TELNO like '010%' then '82' || substr(RCVR_TELNO, 2, 15) else '82' || substr(RCVR_TELNO, 2, 15) end)) as call_to, trim(TRNSPS_TELNO) as call_from, LTR_MSG_TTL_NM as msg_txt_title, 'D' as pcom, CASE WHEN LENGTHB(LTR_MSG_CN) > 90 THEN 'L' ELSE 'S' END AS smskind, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as curr_date, BTN_INCL_STR_CN as btn_1, TMPL_MNG_NO as template_cd, (case when trim(SNDPTY_PROF_VL) = '46248771607c8deab1d586c6167a1bb6c709d00d' then '86ba1bf964556aeafb55d9c70126b102bafd1821' else trim(SNDPTY_PROF_VL) end) as profile_key, NVL(TO_CHAR(RSVT_DT, 'yyyymmddhh24miss'), '00000000000000') as snd_dttm from ${msg_table} where MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '1' and GROUP_NO = '${group_no}' and MSG_SE_CD = '${msg_type}'
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '5', SNDNG_DT = SYSDATE where MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '1' and GROUP_NO = '${group_no}' and MSG_SE_CD = '${msg_type}'
update ${msg_table} set MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '0', GROUP_NO = NULL, SNDNG_DT = NULL where MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '1' and GROUP_NO = '${group_no}' and MSG_SE_CD = '${msg_type}'

update ${msg_table} set MSG_SNDNG_STTS_CD = '${status}', MSG_SNDNG_ERR_CD = '${msg_err_code}', RSND_MSG_SNDNG_TLCMCO_CD = '${agan_tel_info}', SNDNG_CMPTN_DT = TO_TIMESTAMP('${sndg_cpee_dt}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), RSND_MSG_SE_CD = '${agan_sms_type}', RSND_LTR_TRSM_RSLT_CD = '${agan_code}' where DAT_ID = '${msgid}'
mapper.insert: insert into ${log_table} select * from ${msg_table} where DAT_ID = '${msgid}'
